title: Guan Yin 观音
desc: Guan Yin, the Bodhisattva of compassion, is traditionally honoured in the home as a presence of peace and kindness. Consecrated and placed for you by our Master.

title: Golden Wu Lou 葫芦
desc: The Wu Lou is a traditional symbol of health and long life. Its lid opens so written wishes or mantras can be placed inside.

title: Wealth Ingot 元宝
desc: The Yuan Bao ingot is traditionally associated with prosperity (招财). We advise on where in your home it is best placed.
